title: merge_event
description: The record of one decision that two individual records are the same person: who survived, who was folded in, why, who decided, a snapshot of both records, what changed on the survivor and every other record that was re-pointed. It is what makes a merge reversible. A merge_event is written only by the merge handler, never edited, never deleted; an unmerge marks it unmerged. A sender (the operator) supplies only survivor_id, duplicate_id, reason and optional field_choices; everything else is readOnly and set by the server. Endpoint rules the schema cannot express: survivor and duplicate exist, differ, and are each active or inactive; at most one of them holds restricted details; the merge writes the survivor, the duplicate, every re-pointed record and this event in one transaction; an unmerge refuses when the duplicate is no longer merged into the survivor.
x_retention: Kept as long as either person exists. Snapshots are scrubbed to empty objects when either person is erased; the rest of the event (ids, reason removed) stays as proof a merge happened. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

survivor_id.description: The individual that stays. Required. Must be active or inactive, not merged, erased or deleted.

duplicate_id.description: The individual found to be the same person, folded into the survivor. Required. Different from survivor_id, and not merged, erased or deleted.

reason.description: Why the operator decided these are the same person: the evidence in words. Required, up to 500 characters. Personal data.

field_choices.description: Optional per-field decisions where the two records disagree: the field name mapped to survivor (keep the survivor's value) or duplicate (take the duplicate's). Without a choice the server applies the survivorship rules in the guide. Up to 60 fields.

status.description: merged (the merge stands) or unmerged (it was reversed). Set by the server.

survivor_before.description: The survivor's whole record as it was just before the merge. Personal data; scrubbed to an empty object when either person is erased (then the merge can no longer be reversed). Set by the server.

duplicate_before.description: The duplicate's whole record as it was just before the merge. Personal data; scrubbed like survivor_before. Set by the server.

changed_fields.description: What the merge changed on the survivor: one entry per field, with its value before and after. An entry without `before` means the field was absent before; without `after`, it was removed. Set by the server.

before.description: The value before the merge. Absent when the field did not exist.

after.description: The value after the merge. Absent when the field was removed.

moved_links.description: Every other record that pointed at the duplicate and now points at the survivor: its collection, id and field (a dotted path for a nested field), with the value before and after. Unmerge puts back only those whose current value is still the `after` value. Up to 400. Set by the server.

collection.description: The collection of the record that was re-pointed.

id.description: The id of the record that was re-pointed.

field.description: The field that holds the individual id, such as individual_id or payer.party_id.

before.description: The value before: the duplicate's id, or the list that contained it.

after.description: The value after: the survivor's id, or the list with it in place.

unmerged_at.description: When the merge was reversed (UTC). Set by the server.

unmerged_by.description: Who reversed it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

unmerge_skipped.description: What an unmerge could not put back because it had changed since: field and link entries by name and id, no values. Set by the server.

has_erased_snapshots.description: True once a person in this merge was erased and the snapshots were scrubbed. Such a merge cannot be reversed. Set by the server.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the merge happened (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who decided the merge, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed the record. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard. Merges are never made by a public page. Set by the server.
